caption: Hald Hovedgård, Dollerup
composition: A long red-brick manor and its central pavilion above Hald Sø · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Hald Hovedgård is a long single-storey red-brick manor with a half-hipped roof and a taller central pavilion whose middle floor has tall round-arched windows, seen across the lawn with Hald Sø in the foreground. The grounds are empty. It is partly cloudy, about 8.4°C. The wind is light, about 7.6 km/h. Broken cloud partly veils the low morning sun. This is the manor by the lake south of Viborg, not Nørresø and not the medieval ruin.
